for_esotericWebb.evolve: each mirror cycle refines the engine

squads.kenshi: groups of characters with skills, roles, inventories
squads.mirror: each gate IS a squad member with capabilities and state

factions.kenshi: Holy Nation, Shek, United Cities, Hivers, Skeletons
factions.gaia: 8 organs — metabolic, muscular, nervous, digestive, cognitive, immune, endocrine, genetic
factions.mirror: each organ IS a faction with territory and behavior

world_simulation.kenshi: persistent world, NPCs live their lives, economy ticks
world_simulation.mirror: the cron schedule IS the world tick. mushrooms ARE the NPCs.

base_building.kenshi: walls, generators, farms, research benches, storage
base_building.gaia: data files, services, primals, DAG edges
base_building.mirror: every JSON file IS a building. every service IS infrastructure.

combat.kenshi: real-time squad combat, damage types, limb system
combat.gaia: immune system — thymus, V(D)J recombination, antigen detection
combat.mirror: skunkBat IS the martial artist. thymus IS the dojo.

hunger.kenshi: characters need food or they starve and die
hunger.gaia: RSS intake, OSINT feeds, waterlock. no feed = starvation
hunger.mirror: RSS feeds ARE food. mastication IS eating. the gut IS the stomach.

research.mirror: every lesson IS a technology unlocked. every creation IS a blueprint.
